relationship management across Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan Chase. Managed complex 
onboarding projects, drove continuous improvement, reduced operational risk and serving as an escalation point 
for institutional clients and separately managed accounts (SMA) across global markets.

Reporting | VBA Macro Automation | Power BI Dashboards | Team Leadership & Mentoring | Stakeholder & Client 
Management | SLA & Risk Management | People Management | Change Management

Power BI, directly improving turnaround time and enabling team scalability 
• Improved reporting accuracy by 60% through implementation of robust process controls, validation 
frameworks, and standardized SOPs — significantly reducing client escalations 
• Prevented SLA breaches across 100+ monthly client deliverables by proactively managing reporting

• Reduced new hire onboarding time by 25% through structured training programs and comprehensive
